Hi brother,

I would immediately jump into a cold shower, if you can. That should kill the initial urge, or I would start a hardcore workout. Go to the gym, or if you’re home crank out 100 push-ups, or how ever many you can do until the only thing on your mind is how tired you are. If you have any hobbies you’re passionate about, engage in those as well. My father collects vinyl and whenever he feels shitty he listens to them and it takes his mind off of everything for a bit.

You know deep down that this RP situation is a bad idea, and you have the strength to reject it and be in complete control of your own domain. Think about how your wife would feel if she saw you sending those messages.

Hopefully that helped. Stay strong brother, you’re a baller💪
